args.message:
I added up order amount minus the ordering customer's discount for each region. The 16 orders whose customer has no known region are grouped together under null, with a total of 1,143.30.

That null group includes some orders that point to customer IDs not found in the customers table. Because those customers don't exist, there is no discount to subtract, so I counted the discount as 0 and kept the full order amount. If you'd rather leave those orders out entirely (what a plain subtraction would do), the null group's total is 627.83 instead. The four named regions are the same either way.

| Region | Amount minus discount |
|---|---|
| North | 104,835.76 |
| South | 99,462.90 |
| East | 64,730.70 |
| West | 47,717.79 |
| No known region (null) | 1,143.30 |
